regions.name: mainState
regions.what: $0B5D state of the main loop (0 game, 1/2 life lost), $0B5E music, $0B5F re-entry guard of $0DE6, $0B60/$0B61 counters of the level end, $0B62 temp, $0B63 READY countdown

regions.name: checkpoints
regions.what: by level: the low byte of the map pointer of the one checkpoint (page $9A); a death past it restarts there with the wave table of $7AD4

regions.name: readyTexts
regions.what: the screen codes (set $C800) of the READY screen: $0C5B/$0C69 two rows of 14 (A = 0, a life lost), $0C77/$0C91 two rows of 26 (A = $80, GAME OVER), $0CAB/$0CBC two rows of 17 and $0CCD/$0CCF, $0CD1/$0CD3 the 1UP/2UP tails (A = 1, the start of a level)

regions.name: tapeEndTexts
regions.what: after GAME OVER: 18 at $CC33 (PLEASE REWIND TAPE), 12 at $CC86, $CCD6 (THEN PRESS / F1 TO START), two rows of 12 loaded and never stored ($5EB6-$5EBF: OR / F3 2 PLAYER), 18 at $CCFB (PRESS PLAY ON TAPE)

regions.name: blink
regions.what: $1190 0 = invulnerable and blinking, $80 = vulnerable; $1191 frames left ($78)

regions.name: gameState
regions.what: $2805-$2818 the two players' saved ship state, $2819 player, $281A/$281B ?, $281C deaths, $281D/$281E lives, $281F ?, $2820 two players

regions.name: gameStateInit
regions.what: copied to $2805 at the start of a game

regions.name: rowLo
regions.what: screen row addresses $CC00+40*row, low bytes

regions.name: rowHi
regions.what: high bytes

regions.name: forceTables
regions.what: by Force level $33 (0-4): $2FA4 sprite pointer, $2FA9 last animation pointer, $2FAE animation speed, $2FB3 X offset behind, $2FB8 X offset in front, $2FBD Y offset

regions.name: forceVars
regions.what: $2FC2-$2FC7 the level's six values, $2FC8 width and $2FCD height in characters by level, $2FD2/$2FD3 return direction X/Y, $2FD4 ship X high, $2FD5/$2FD6 colour cycle, $2FD7/$2FD8 drift counters, $2FD9/$2FDA drift

regions.name: forceColors
regions.what: the colour cycle of sprite 0 ($D027)

regions.name: bitsVars
regions.what: $3079 upper bit, $307A lower bit, $307B frame counter (6), $307C animation phase (0-7)

regions.name: bitsAddr

regions.name: bitsFrames

regions.name: bitsShapes

regions.name: bitsSrc2

regions.name: bitsDst2

regions.name: score

regions.name: oneUp

regions.name: sounds

regions.name: fireRoutine

extraLifeScore.where: $32EE: a carry out of the 10 000s digit — every 100 000 points, sound 6

readyCountdown.where: $0B70: frames of the READY screen before fire is read ($0C27)

readyColors.where: $0BFF-$0C1A: $D022/$D023 between rasters $42 and $82 (the text rows 7-8), and from $82 on

levelEndFrames.where: $0A20, $0A25: 288 frames of the ship flying to the centre ($0ADB) after a level

ending.where: $0A7B: level $D3 loads E and runs $8000; its credits end in a RESET
